svg.title: Who owns the discharge connection?
svg.desc: Six annotated scenes for a five-minute local demonstration. A published MK case introduces a fictional application. The customer confirms a brief, the MK demo perspective asks an interface question, and the customer reviews and confirms an answer. Both perspectives see revision 2. The photo is from MK’s published case; the other frames are schematic, not application screenshots.

svg.text: MK NORTH AMERICA / APPLICATION STUDIO CONCEPT
Five-minute storyboard / One published case photo and five schematic frames. No app screenshots.
The sample that follows is fictional;
Show the published installation, then open the local sample.
Leave the discharge connection open for discussion.
Only the customer’s confirmation creates revision 1.
Who will provide the discharge connection
Switch to MK demo view. The question stays on revision 1.
Add a demo clarification / Add to demo project
Return to Customer view, respond, then review the change.
The editable answer stays a draft until the customer confirms.
Revision 1 remains available. Engineering agreement is open.
Discuss the layout drawing and where controls responsibility starts.
Evaluate one authorized inquiry with MK.
A customer answer starts the engineering discussion.
Local demo only. No inquiry, notification, quote or engineering approval. This storyboard is not a rendered film.

a.text: Photo source: MK’s published tube-feeding case
